hall_of_fame.title: [React 19] Disabling prerendering siblings of suspended components breaking common pattern
hall_of_fame.one_line_why: React's concurrent rendering advancements and new Cache API enable a solution.

hall_of_fame.title: Consider re-licensing to AL v2.0, as RocksDB has just done
hall_of_fame.one_line_why: RocksDB re‑licensing to Apache‑2.0/GPL‑2 demonstrates feasibility for React and reflects broader open‑source license harmonization trends.

hall_of_fame.title: cmd/go: "package … is not in GOROOT" is confusing in module mode when the package would exist in GOPATH mode
hall_of_fame.one_line_why: Go modules became the default build system in Go 1.16, changing module vs GOPATH behavior.

last_resurrection.title: Ability to write cookies
last_resurrection.one_line_why: The introduction of the Streamlit SessionState API and HTTP‑only cookie support in browsers enables this feature.
last_resurrection.one_line_summary: Streamlit should provide built‑in cookie management to persist user authentication across sessions.
